method: historical replay with actual production consumers and real PydanticAI API

assumptions.funding: not modeled (zero); net results exclude funding
assumptions.execution: existing GM/ExecutionPort MARKET semantics at latest known M1 close plus adverse slippage; pending signal is not a resting stop order
